Delivery chain

Solid arrows lead to recorded completed stages; dotted arrows show remaining dependencies. Direct API and UI proof run in parallel, and both feed the live behavior gate. Statuses come from the tracker, not live GitHub.

Each milestone PR needs a final local rubber-duck and code-review pair on its current head before readiness. After issue-specific API/UI and GitHub gates pass, authorize gh pr merge --rebase --auto one PR at a time; monitor until merged before admitting the next.

Platform integrity checks establish setup only; they do not pass the live behavior gate.

Milestone issues and linked PRs

Green = complete, blue = active, red = blocked or failed; gray = pending or unrecorded. “Not run” means no evidence recorded for the current PR head, not proof that a review or CI check never ran. The GitHub gate is manually recorded PR/CI readiness, not live GitHub status.
